gzipPolicy: Fully decoded and scanned. Deterministic gzip after path substitution. Exact inverse of decoded text; original compressed container bytes are not reproduced.
approvalPolicy: Original approvals bind original bytes only. Rebased files and changed dependency hashes require explicit fresh review. No approval or runtime admission inherited.
dependencyPolicy: Only listed editing files and optional exact native PNG bindings are included. Previously archived source09 metadata, native PNGs and old host application trees are not duplicated. Missing dependencies are reported, never guessed.
sourceSHAAndCalibrationPolicy: Only four path prefixes substituted. Every decoded original byte is preserved by exact inverse substitution, including all numerical geometry, source SHA, native height, pivot, clip, role and weapon-point values.
